title: Controller
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast. Candidates in the NYC area have a hybrid option.

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits tailored to factors such as location, role complexity, and experience. The estimated base salary range is $190K- $215K per year.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation.

title: Customer Success Enablement Specialist
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership
  • Continuous Enablement: Develop post-onboarding curricula that keep the team sharp on new feature releases, industry trends, and advanced account management strategies ; including expansion positioning from upselling and cross-selling
  • Needs Assessment: Identify knowledge and skill gaps through data-driven assessments, aligning all training programs to revenue priorities and business objectives
  • Blended Learning Delivery: Develop and deliver engaging learning experiences - including live workshops, virtual sessions, and eLearning - for global CS teams of all experience levels
  • Tactical Content Creation: Build practical exercises, job aids, and visual guides that translate technical API capabilities and product updates into actionable "Success Plays"
  • Tools & Stack Mastery: Serve as the subject matter expert for the CS toolset (Gong, Salesforce andPlanhat,ensuring the team navigates our systems with speed and precision
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with CS Leadership to drive accountability and partner with Sales Enablement to ensure cohesive product and process updates across the revenue org
  • Advocacy & Improvement: Serve as a trusted advisor and champion for continuous improvement in CS skills, processes, and training best practices.

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science.

Required:

  • CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus
  • The "CS Lens" on Sales Process: A solid understanding of the B2B lifecycle. You understand how discovery, handoffs, and pipeline management directly impact long-term retention and expansion.
  • CS Tech Stack Power User: High proficiency in Salesforce and Planhat (or similar CS Platform such as Gainsight, Totango, Hubspot, Zendesk, and Churn Zero etc.). You are comfortable being the "go-to" expert who helps others navigate our tools with speed and precision
  • Instructional Design Mastery: Experience creating clean, professional training materials, slide decks, and tutorials. Proficiency in Articulate (or similar authoring tools) is required to build our eLearning library
  • Strong Facilitation Skills: You are a confident, engaging presenter who can break down complex API capabilities or process-heavy workflows into simple, actionable steps.

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: Ability to work effectively with Sales/CS Ops, Product Marketing, and CS Managers to ensure content is technically accurate and relevant to the field
  • Detail-Oriented & Precise: A passion for accuracy and a "get it right" mindset when documenting internal processes and system workflows
  • Strategic Advisor: A champion for continuous improvement who isn't afraid to identify skill gaps and propose creative solutions to fill them
  • Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.

Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Spain.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Spain is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. #LI-HB

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

title: Field Marketer - Southern Europe (Freelance)
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Field marketing is at the heart of how we build demand, foster community, deepen customer relationships, and accelerate growth. We are looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Field Marketing Manager to build the engine that fills the funnel for our Southern Europe GTM team, focused on two to three priority industries: healthcare, financial services, telco, and retail and e-commerce.

Your expertise in industry-led field marketing strategy, regional program execution, and GTM partnership will be pivotal in creating the moments that bring enterprise buyers to the table, from executive dinners and roadshows to industry conferences, roundtables, and account-based programs aimed at named buying committees. Collaborating closely with the Southern European GTM team and the broader marketing team, you will own every stage of the field motion, from territory and account strategy through budgeting, on-site execution, and post-program pipeline attribution.

ElevenAgents is being evaluated today by customer experience and contact center leaders at the largest health systems, banks, carriers, and retailers in Southern Europe. Your ability to think like a marketer, act like a salesperson, and run multiple industry programs at once will ensure we get in front of them first.

What you’ll do

  • Build the engine that fills the funnel for your industries, a repeatable program mix that creates net new pipeline quarter over quarter

  • Develop and execute the Southern Europe field plan for two to three industries, from territory and account strategy through budget, execution, and attribution

  • Partner with Enterprise and Strategic account executives on named account lists. Agree the targets, fill the room, drive the follow-up.

  • Design the program mix: executive dinners, industry conferences, roadshows, roundtables, customer advisory sessions, and 1:few account-based plays

  • Create the vertical narrative with Product Marketing. Invite copy, talk tracks, and follow-up sequences that speak to a healthcare, banking, telco, or retail buyer, not a generic one.

  • Manage event budgets and timelines, and report pipeline created and cost per opportunity, program by program

  • Analyze program performance in Salesforce and Dream Data and give an honest read on what worked. Recommend what to scale and what to retire.

  • Follow up with participants in collaboration with the GTM and growth teams

  • Work with Paid Media and Demand Generation to amplify field programs before and after they run

  • Own end to end execution, with support from the Southern Europe events team on venue, vendors, logistics, and on-site delivery

Requirements

We are more focused on hiring for potential than past experience, but the person who thrives here will bring most of the following.

  • 7+ years in B2B field, industry, or regional marketing, with a demonstrated track record of building programs that directly influenced pipeline and closed revenue

  • Deep experience marketing into at least two of: healthcare, financial services, telco, retail and e-commerce

  • Track record reaching enterprise buying committees on six and seven figure deals

  • Fluency in Salesforce and marketing attribution. You can defend your numbers in a pipeline review.

  • A peer relationship with GTM. You have pushed back on an account executive and been right.

  • Comfortable running an executive dinner, speaking at events, and partnering with C-level stakeholders inside and outside the company

  • Sharp judgment on what to cut. Budget and calendar discipline under tight deadlines.

  • Willing to travel roughly a third of the time across Southern Europe

  • Transparent and unafraid to challenge, ask questions, or call out obstacles

  • An AI-first working style, and a passion for ElevenLabs technology

  • Bias toward shipping

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Clinical Intake Specialist
description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

About the job

The Clinical Intake Specialist is an integral member of the Enhanced Care Management (ECM) team. In this role, the Clinical Intake Specialist works directly with clients to understand their needs and then connect them to the correct resource on our primary care management team. The successful candidate will be personable and professional via phone, able to quickly review medical charts and understand medical conditions, provide person-centered care, prioritize tasks effectively to support client engagement, and be motivated to help high need individuals with complex care needs.

At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states: Arizona, California (LVNs), Colorado, Illinois, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, Utah, and Washington.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct outreach to newly referred clients and log activity in VyncaOS

  • Conduct 8-12 intake visits daily, ensuring efficient and accurate assessments

  • Assist clients in completing initial intake visit including a psychosocial assessment and care plan with goals of care

  • Review medical charts and document client medical needs and suggested interventions

  • Communicate critical information and client preferences to the care team for personalized care planning

  • Utilize evidence-based practices, such as Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care principles

  • Attend weekly Team Operations Meetings

  • Maintain a structured and organized schedule to optimize client intake and engagement

  • When unscheduled, perform proactive outreach to no-shows or clients who have not been contacted previously

  • Stay available for warm transfers from field teams, ensuring same-day responses

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with an emphasis on meeting key performance metrics

Your experience and qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted California Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) license, or Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or Medical Assistant certificate issued by a recognized group (AAH, AAMA, AMT, NCCT, or NHA)

  • Minimum of 2 years of previous intake or admissions experience in a high call volume environment

  • Experience working with complex care clients and ECM Populations of Focus

  • Experience with Health Gorilla or Health Record Systems

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Positive interpersonal skills with a collaborative attitude

  • Expert computer skills and proficiency in Google Workspace, MS Office, and internet tools

  • Ability to work independently and stay highly motivated

  • Capable of managing multiple tasks and navigating various platforms, with the ability to adapt and shift priorities as needed

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) highly preferred

  • Willing and able to work Monday-Friday 8:30am-5pm Pacific Time, with the possibility of evenings and weekends

Keywords: Patient Intake, Admissions, Biopsychosocial Assessments, Individualized Care Plans, Healthcare, Remote

Additional Information

  • The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks.

  • Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment.

  • Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein.

  • Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved.

  • Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire.

  • Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.

  • Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below:

    • Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing.

    • Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks).

    • Regularly requires use of laptop and video-conferencing technology.

    • Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less.

    • Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events.

description:
For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.

As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:

Job Duck is seeking a highly organized and proactive Administrative and Client Services Coordinator to provide direct administrative support while helping coordinate client service, marketing activities, and day to day priorities. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy professional environment, communicating clearly with clients and internal teams, and taking ownership of follow ups before they fall through the cracks. The successful candidate will manage calendars, communications, task lists, client outreach, reporting, and a mix of business and personal administrative needs while helping leadership stay focused on high priority legal and growth initiatives. Someone who is resourceful, tech savvy, customer service oriented, and comfortable balancing changing priorities will thrive in this position.


  • Monthly Compensation Range: $1,040 to $1,100 USD

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Follow up with current clients by phone, email, or SMS to ensure they are receiving appropriate support.

  • Conduct outbound calls and schedule appointments as needed.

  • Reconnect with former clients to maintain relationships and share relevant information about upcoming seminars and firm activities.

  • Act as a communication buffer between leadership and the broader team, helping streamline requests, follow ups, and information flow.

  • Coordinate personal scheduling needs, including appointments and other time sensitive commitments.

  • Monitor outstanding items and proactively follow up with internal team members, clients, and other stakeholders.

  • Help monitor overall team activities and provide visibility into priorities, outstanding work, and follow up needs.

  • Check in with clients about their experience, outstanding needs, and upcoming appointments or services.

  • Maintain accurate client follow up activity within Lawmatics, Clio, and other applicable systems.

  • Use Asana or similar task management software to organize assignments, deadlines, and priorities.

  • Coordinate across legal, client service, administrative, and marketing priorities while adjusting quickly as needs change.

  • Identify opportunities to improve organization, communication, follow up, and administrative efficiency.

  • Anticipate upcoming needs and take proactive action to keep projects, client communications, and executive priorities moving forward.

  • Use CRM workflows and tools to support consistent client outreach and prevent follow ups from being missed.

  • Provide administrative and logistical support to the existing marketing team.

  • Help coordinate marketing activities, deadlines, communications, and scheduling to keep initiatives organized and on track.

  • Support marketing activities associated with real estate matters and related business initiatives.

  • Use Cytracom or related communication tools to support professional phone interactions.

  • Handle sensitive client, business, and personal information with appropriate confidentiality and discretion.
  • Serve as a personal and executive assistant, providing day to day administrative support and helping leadership remain focused on high priority matters.

  • Manage email correspondence, calendars, appointments, scheduling, reminders, and recurring commitments.

  • Maintain and organize comprehensive task lists, ensuring priorities and deadlines are clearly tracked.

  • Help prioritize client matters, legal work, administrative responsibilities, marketing activities, cash flow related tasks, and personal obligations.

  • Assist with reporting, status updates, administrative tracking, and other operational support requirements.

  • Support the Client Service Coordinator team with administrative tasks, client communications, scheduling, and relationship management.

Requirements:

  • Full time availability during 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English with clear verbal communication skills
  • Previous administrative, executive assistant, personal assistant, client service, or similar professional experience
  • Previous experience working in a law firm or legal services environment is preferred
  • Experience supporting attorneys, executives, business owners, or other professionals with competing priorities is preferred
  • Comfortable communicating with current and former clients by phone, email, and SMS
  • Ability to make outbound calls, conduct client follow ups, and schedule appointments
  • Strong calendar, email, task, and priority management capabilities
  • Ability to organize and prioritize legal client work, administrative responsibilities, marketing activities, cash flow related follow ups, and personal tasks
  • Comfortable supporting marketing administration and coordinating logistical activities with an existing marketing team
  • Tech savvy and able to learn new software and workflows efficiently
  • Familiarity with Lawmatics and Clio or comparable legal practice management and CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with task and project management software such as Asana
  • Familiarity with Cytracom or comparable VoIP platforms

title: Corporate Traveler Stage & Screen - After Hours Travel Consultant - Remote, USA
description:
After Hours Travel Consultant

Stage & Screen is the entertainment and sports travel specialist within the Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), trusted by some of the world’s most high-profile touring artists, athletes, production teams, and media companies. Our mission is simple: to make complex travel effortless — delivering tailored, agile solutions that help our clients perform at their peak, wherever the spotlight takes them.

We understand the fast-paced, high-stakes nature of the creative and sporting worlds. That’s why we blend white-glove, personalized service with cutting-edge travel technology and the global buying power of FCTG. Whether it’s a world tour, film shoot, major tournament, or red carpet event, our dedicated experts ensure seamless travel, every time.

As part of the Corporate Traveler family - one of FCTG’s most successful global brands, we also benefit from a world-class support network and decades of experience in simplifying business travel. With a presence in Australia, Canada, the USA, UK, South Africa, and New Zealand, Corporate Traveller has been helping small to mid-sized enterprises grow through smarter travel solutions for over 26 years.

Award-winning, fast-moving, and built on collaboration and purpose — we’re a team that thrives on energy, excellence, and the power of partnership. If you’re passionate about service, driven by deadlines, and excited by the buzz of live entertainment and sport, this could be your next big role.

To learn more about Corporate Traveler please click HERE

About The Opportunity

As part of the After Hours Support Team, you help deliver exceptional travel management services for Stage and Screen clients during non-business hours when day teams are unavailable. You provide direct, hands-on support to production crews, touring artists, athletic teams, entertainment executives, and sports professionals, managing urgent travel needs and critical travel disruptions common in the fast-paced entertainment and sports industries.

Working within a fully remote team, you handle client interactions via phone and email with professionalism, speed, and care, escalating operational questions to the Leader on Shift (LOS) as needed. Your contributions ensure the client experience maintains Corporate Traveler's high standards of service excellence, adapting to the unique demands of entertainment productions, touring schedules, and sporting events.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure a high level of client satisfaction with their Corporate Traveler after-hours experience by exceeding customer service expectations via phone and email.
  • Utilize Sabre GDS and various booking platforms including NDC and web-based programs to arrange accurate business travel reservations, including air, car, hotel, and ground transportation.
  • Respond to urgent travel needs, production delays, event changes, and last-minute itinerary modifications for Stage and Screen clients.
  • Follow company procedures, account guidelines, and customer service standards.
  • Escalate complex issues, disruptions, or high-value client situations to the Leader on Shift (LOS) as appropriate.
  • Work as a team member, assisting other agents as needed to complete all functions related to servicing the client.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.
  • Develop working knowledge of entertainment and sports travel requirements, including group movements, tour logistics, and event-driven schedules.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience with a GDS system, Sabre preferred.
  • Customer-focused, consistently going above and beyond to deliver an amazing client experience.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and ability to build strong business relationships.
  • A problem solver who thinks outside the box to provide creative solutions.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to effectively multi-task and shift gears in time-sensitive situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Positive attitude with a hunger for knowledge, able to work well under pressure and adapt to change.
  • Tech savvy and comfortable learning new software.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with various shifts including weekends, overnights, and holidays—flexibility is a MUST.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, US

title: Gestionnaire documentation import (H/F)
description:
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous accompagnez les équipes opérationnelles dans la gestion administrative et documentaire des opérations d’importation vers l’Union européenne.

Vous assurez la préparation et le suivi des documents sanitaires ainsi que l’ouverture des dossiers d’exploitation dans CargoWise. Vous veillez à l’exactitude et à l’exhaustivité des informations traitées, dans le respect des délais et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront :

Gestion des documents d’importation

  • Créer et traiter les CHED (Common Health Entry Documents) dans TRACES NT.

  • Saisir et vérifier les certificats de capture (Catch Certificates).

  • Contrôler l’exactitude et l’exhaustivité des documents nécessaires aux opérations d’importation.

  • Identifier les informations manquantes ou incorrectes et assurer le suivi auprès des interlocuteurs concernés.

  • Assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers conformément à la réglementation européenne.

Création et mise à jour des dossiers d’exploitation

  • Recueillir les pièces nécessaires à la constitution des dossiers transport.

  • Ouvrir les dossiers d’exploitation dans le TMS CargoWise.

  • Intégrer les documents dans le TMS et veiller à la bonne tenue des dossiers.

Support aux équipes opérationnelles

  • Apporter un soutien administratif quotidien aux activités d’importation et de dédouanement.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles sur les documents requis et l’avancement des dossiers.

  • Veiller à la transmission des informations et au traitement des documents dans les délais impartis.

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Vous disposez de connaissances de base en transit international, en organisation des expéditions et en Incoterms.

  • Vous comprenez les différentes étapes d’une opération d’importation : de l’expéditeur à la livraison finale, en passant par le transport international, le contrôle documentaire et le dédouanement.

  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin d’échanger au quotidien avec vos interlocuteurs.

  • Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et d’attention aux détails.

  • Vous savez gérer vos priorités et respecter les échéances.

  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les fonctions de support aux opérations.

Les atouts qui feront la différence :

  • Une connaissance de TRACES NT et/ou de CargoWise.

  • Une connaissance de la réglementation européenne relative aux importations et à la sécurité alimentaire.

  • Une expérience dans le traitement documentaire de produits de la pêche, alimentaires ou agricoles.

  • La maîtrise du français et/ou de l’arabe.

Finance Close Automation Solution Designer, Malta

Contract: 6 Months , extension highly likely. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Malta. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its financial close. You will design the automated close and work alongside a Redwood platform engineer who builds it.

What you will work on

Design the automated close: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the close calendar. Design balance sheet reconciliation, auto-certification, accruals and journal posting. Work with the platform engineer to turn the design into running automation.

What you bring

Hands-on design of an automated close in SAP Financial Closing cockpit, SAP Advanced Financial Closing (AFC), BlackLine or Trintech Cadency. Balance sheet reconciliation, auto-certification, accruals and journal posting. SAP FI/CO. 8+ years' experience.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation or SAP CPS/BPA exposure.

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent close automation project: the close processes in scope, the tool and ERP it ran on, and which design decisions were yours.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services.

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
